title: Interpreting CLIP with Hierarchical Sparse Autoencoders

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the statistical distribution of Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) concept magnitudes against predictions from a downstream binary gender classifier trained on CLIP embeddings using the CelebA dataset. The evaluation also includes concept-level interventions, manipulating the magnitudes of specific concepts (e.g., 'bearded', 'blonde', 'glasses') in the SAE space to observe their causal impact on gender classification probabilities.
